Content.SourceString: 哒啦啦~哒-啦啦~哒啦啦哒↑↓啦啦~
Content.LocalizedString: Da-la-la♪ Da-la-la♪ Da-la-la-da↑↓ la-la♪

Content.SourceString: 这是什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What's this?

Content.SourceString: 噔↗噔→噔↓噔↑噔↑?
Content.LocalizedString: Dun↗ dun→ dun↓ dun↑ dun↑♪

Content.SourceString: 你回得这么严肃，显得我跑来朋友小窗唱歌的行为很幼稚><
Content.LocalizedString: You answered so seriously, it makes my popping into a friend's DMs just to sing seem really childish ><

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师怎么发语音！（笑）
Content.LocalizedString: The Appraiser's sending voice messages? (lol)

Content.SourceString: 《特工Z世代》新剧场版的主题曲真是太洗脑了，今天一醒来就在脑子里单曲循环。
Content.LocalizedString: The theme song from the new Gen Z movie is such an earworm; it's been stuck on repeat in my head since I woke up today.

Content.SourceString: 海月也会听动画歌曲吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Aurelia, do you listen to anime songs too?

Content.SourceString: 当然会听呀，动画歌曲可是个相当庞大的领域。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course I listen to them. Anime songs are a pretty huge world in their own right.

Content.SourceString: 虽然也有比较通用的经典曲风，但近年来，给动画配乐的音乐人们越来越多地尝试更独特的风格。
Content.LocalizedString: There are still the usual classic styles... but lately anime composers have been getting bolder, experimenting with much more distinctive sounds.

Content.SourceString: 就算不怎么看动画的人也能从中找到自己喜欢的曲子呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Even people who hardly watch anime can still find songs they like in it.

Content.SourceString: 对了，鉴定师喜欢什么样的风格？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, Appraiser, what kind of style do you like?

Content.SourceString: 经典动画歌曲吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Classic anime songs.

Content.SourceString: 快节奏的硬核摇滚吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's go with fast-paced hardcore rock.

Content.SourceString: 温柔治愈的抒情歌吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Gentle, soothing ballads.

Content.SourceString: 那你肯定和哈尼娅很有共同语言吧XD
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like you and Haniel really click, huh? XD

Content.SourceString: 哦哦！娜娜莉好像也很喜欢这个，
Content.LocalizedString: Ooh! Nanally seems to really like this too!

Content.SourceString: 原来如此。那我要偷偷告诉鉴定师，别看明音那副酷酷的样子，她其实最喜欢的也是抒情歌哦。
Content.LocalizedString: I see. I'm gonna let it slip and tell you that, despite Akane's cool act, she actually loves ballads!

Content.SourceString: 说起来，海月喜欢什么样的歌？
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, what kind of songs do you like, Aurelia?

Content.SourceString: 我什么风格都很喜欢，一下子挑不出来……
Content.LocalizedString: I like pretty much every style—I can't pick just one…

Content.SourceString: 不过要说讨厌的，倒是可以立刻选出来。之前在一场「月亮狗之夜」里，我听到了这辈子最难听的歌……
Content.LocalizedString: But if we're talking about songs I hate, one pops into my head right away. Back during a Night of Moondog event, I heard the worst song of my entire life…

Content.SourceString: 可偏偏它最难听的副歌部分特别洗脑，听了一次就忘不掉。之后至少两个月，它动不动就在我脑内自动播放。
Content.LocalizedString: But the worst part—the chorus—was also insanely catchy… Heard it once and I couldn't get it out of my head. For at least two months it kept looping in my brain.

Content.SourceString: 我会永远诅咒它的作者！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll curse the song's author forever!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Now I kinda want to hear it.
Lucky that I've never heard of it.

Content.SourceString: 这么难听？我反而想听听看了。
Content.LocalizedString: That bad? Kinda makes me want to hear it.

Content.SourceString: 还好我还有一双没听过这首歌的耳朵，
Content.LocalizedString: Good thing I've still got a pair of ears that haven't caught that earworm yet.

Content.SourceString: 你是觉得不会有音源才这么说的吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You're only saying that because you're sure there's no way to actually hear it, right?

Content.SourceString: 说吧你出多少钱，把那双耳朵卖给我！
Content.LocalizedString: Go on then, name your price! I'll buy those ears off you!

Content.SourceString: 不过，因为实在太难听，它的专辑反而卖得很好。可能大家都想听听到底有多难听吧。
Content.LocalizedString: But because it was so awful, the album actually sold really well. I guess everyone wanted to hear for themselves how bad it was.

Content.SourceString: 其实我也买了一张，虽然买回来就从来没听过……
Content.LocalizedString: I actually bought a copy too, even though I've never listened to it since…

Content.SourceString: 下次要是鉴定师和我玩游戏输了，就惩罚你把它听完好了XD
Content.LocalizedString: Next time the Appraiser loses to me in a game, I'll punish you by making you listen to the whole thing. XD

Content.SourceString: 惊恐.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: Fear.jpg

Content.SourceString: 提问：如果鉴定师的异能也突然变成了操纵海洋生物，你想选哪一种？
Content.LocalizedString: Q&A: If the Appraiser's Esper Ability suddenly became controlling sea creatures, which would you pick?

Content.SourceString: 海洋生物？
Content.LocalizedString: Sea creatures?

Content.SourceString: 现在就变？
Content.LocalizedString: Right now?

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯，就像我的水母那样。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm—just like my jellyfish.

Content.SourceString: 你有5分钟考虑时间XD
Content.LocalizedString: You've got 5 minutes to think it over XD

Content.SourceString: 其实是娜娜莉突然问我，有没有什么海洋生物很像老虎……
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, Nanally suddenly asked me if there's any sea creature that looks like a tiger…

Content.SourceString: 我回答虎鲨之后，她就说如果异能是操纵虎鲨也不错。
Content.LocalizedString: After I said "tiger shark," she was like, "If my Esper Ability could control tiger sharks, that'd be pretty cool too."

Content.SourceString: 接着哈尼娅也来问我，那有没有什么海洋生物像猫头鹰，比如「猫头鹰鲨」之类的。
Content.LocalizedString: Then Haniel asked me: are there any ocean creatures that look like owls? Like an "owl shark" or something.

Content.SourceString: 我一时想不出来，她说那就没办法了，只好选小飞象章鱼了。
Content.LocalizedString: I couldn't think of anything on the spot, so she shrugged and said there was no other choice—we'd just have to go with the Little Flying Octopus.

Content.SourceString: ……确实很像她俩的风格。
Content.LocalizedString: …Yeah, that's totally her style.

Content.SourceString: 顺带一提我也去问了明音，她说想要鲸鱼。
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, I asked Akane too—she said she wants a whale.

Content.SourceString: 然后海月就来问我了啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Then Aurelia came over and asked me.

Content.SourceString: 我很好奇鉴定师的答案！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm dying to hear the Appraiser's answer!

Content.SourceString: 海豚吧，印象里好像是很聪明的动物。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd say dolphins. I recall they're supposed to be really smart animals.

Content.SourceString: 如果异能是操纵海獭的话，好像很有意思。
Content.LocalizedString: If my Esper Ability let me control sea otters, that'd actually be pretty fun.

Content.SourceString: 总感觉会很自由。
Content.LocalizedString: As seaweed, I feel like I'd finally be free.

Content.SourceString: 没错，海豚聪明又友善，甚至能成为人类船只的领航员。感觉很适合鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Totally—dolphins are smart and friendly; they even guide human ships. They'd be perfect for the Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 不知道对塔吉多有没有用。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't know if that'd be any use to Taygedo.

Content.SourceString: 自、自由吗……？想象了一下，晃动起来，好像是很解压……？
Content.LocalizedString: F-freedom…? I tried picturing it, and if you kinda just sway… it could be oddly calming…?

Content.SourceString: 要是有了一支海獭大军，吃贝类时剥壳会很方便吧！
Content.LocalizedString: If I had a whole army of otters, cracking shells for seafood would be so easy!

Content.SourceString: 顺带一问，如果海月的异能变成操纵某种陆地生物的话，你会选什么？
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, if Aurelia's Esper Ability turned into the power to control some kind of land creature, what would you pick?

Content.SourceString: 水豚。
Content.LocalizedString: Capybara.

Content.SourceString: 水豚？
Content.LocalizedString: Capybara?

Content.SourceString: 很擅长游泳、跑得不算慢但是很稳当、情绪很稳定。
Content.LocalizedString: Good at swimming, not fast on the run but steady on their feet—and emotionally rock‑solid.

Content.SourceString: 而且，总感觉被很多水豚包围的话很治愈。
Content.LocalizedString: There's something healing about being surrounded by capybaras.

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师想要水母挂件吗？我的志愿者积分又可以换一个啦XD
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, Appraiser, want a jellyfish pendant? I've got enough volunteer points to redeem another one XD

Content.SourceString: 如果你想要的话，下次带一个给你？
Content.LocalizedString: If you want, I can bring one for you next time.

Content.SourceString: 志愿者？
Content.LocalizedString: Where do you volunteer?

Content.SourceString: 海月已经换过很多个了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Has Aurelia already gone through a bunch of them?

Content.SourceString: 是水族馆啦。我上学的时候就经常在那边做志愿者。
Content.LocalizedString: An aquarium. I used to volunteer there a lot when I was in school.

Content.SourceString: 50工时就可以换一个，我早就把全系列都集齐了。
Content.LocalizedString: You can redeem one for every 50 hours. I finished the whole set ages ago.

Content.SourceString: 最近的志愿活动是去海滩上宣传不要乱丢垃圾。因为可以去海边，所以我报满了周末所有时间段。
Content.LocalizedString: The latest volunteer event was a beach campaign to encourage people not to litter. Since it meant I'd get to go to the seaside, I signed up for every weekend slot!

Content.SourceString: 虽然天很热，稍微有点辛苦，不过成效很显著呢~
Content.LocalizedString: It was scorching and a bit rough, but the results were totally worth it!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Just hearing that wears me out.

Content.SourceString: 听着就觉得累了……海月的精力还真是旺盛。
Content.LocalizedString: Just hearing that sounds exhausting… Aurelia really is bursting with energy.

Content.SourceString: 听上去好像很有意思。我也想参加。
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds like fun — I want in, too.

Content.SourceString: 是这样吗？实际上还好啦，比帮忙打扫水族馆和为科普活动打下手之类的活动轻松很多。
Content.LocalizedString: Really? It's not that bad, actually — way easier than scrubbing aquarium tanks or helping out at those public science events.

Content.SourceString: 那下次再有去海边的活动，我来通知鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Next time there's a trip to the beach, I'll let the Appraiser know!

Content.SourceString: 不过，海月平时都要工作，周末还要去当志愿者吗？
Content.LocalizedString: But you work on weekdays — you still volunteer on weekends?

Content.SourceString: 不会很累吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't you get tired?

Content.SourceString: 因为是我喜欢的事，所以完全不会累哦？
Content.LocalizedString: Because volunteering is something I love, it never tires me at all!

Content.SourceString: 不如说，工作本身就是我喜欢的事，所以平时上班也不会觉得特别辛苦。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, my job itself is something I enjoy too, so going to work every day never feels all that exhausting.

Content.SourceString: ……不过，我这么说可能有点狡猾。因为真正辛苦的大概不是我吧。
Content.LocalizedString: …But saying that feels a bit sly coming from me… I'm probably not the one who's really been burdened.

Content.SourceString: 不是海月的话，是谁？
Content.LocalizedString: If it's not you, Aurelia, who is it?

Content.SourceString: 当然是一直载着我跑来跑去的水母啦。
Content.LocalizedString: Obviously it's the jellyfish that's been carting me around everywhere!

Content.SourceString: 心虚.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: Guilty-Looking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你是不是能听懂歧骸的语言？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser—can you actually understand the Oddities' language?

Content.SourceString: 比如团三郎的……
Content.LocalizedString: Like Danzaburou's…

Content.SourceString: 我确实能理解一部分。怎么了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I can sort of understand. What's the matter?

Content.SourceString: 玉饼街上的猫丸拉面，最近一直都在丢食材。治安所查了几天，也没发现犯人的踪迹。
Content.LocalizedString: Nekomaru Ramen on Tamamochi Street has had ingredients stolen repeatedly lately. The Security Office has been investigating for days, but they haven't found any sign of the culprit.

Content.SourceString: 今天店主假装出门，实际上一直在店里蹲守。结果，抓到了一只团三郎……
Content.LocalizedString: Today, the shopkeeper pretended to head out but actually hid in the shop the whole time. In the end, she caught a Danzaburou…

Content.SourceString: 店主不相信这么小一只歧骸能偷走那么多食材，就想对它进行「审讯」。
Content.LocalizedString: The shopkeeper doesn't believe such a tiny Oddity could have stolen that many ingredients, so she wants to "interrogate" it.

OptionText.LocalizedString: So you want me to be the translator?

Content.SourceString: 所以，海月是想让我来当翻译，听听团三郎的……「证词」？
Content.LocalizedString: So Aurelia wants me to play translator and hear Danzaburou's… "testimony"?

Content.SourceString: 是这样。当然，如果鉴定师方便的话……
Content.LocalizedString: That's right. Of course, only if it's convenient for the Appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 恳求.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: entreat.jpg

Content.SourceString: 我正好有空。呃，「当事团三郎」怎么说？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm free. Uh, what does the Danzaburou involved have to say?

Content.SourceString: 「一段好像很生气的叫声.mp3」
Content.LocalizedString: A furious shout.mp3

Content.SourceString: 「一段好像很委屈的叫声.mp3」
Content.LocalizedString: A clip of a wronged-sounding cry.mp3

Content.SourceString: ……大概是这样。
Content.LocalizedString: …I guess that's about right.

Content.SourceString: 它说犯人不是它。它听说这家店有好吃的，今天才会过来，可什么都没吃到就被抓起来了。
Content.LocalizedString: It says it's not the culprit. It only came because it heard this place had good food — but it got caught before it could eat a single bite.

Content.SourceString: 语气……听起来不像说谎。
Content.LocalizedString: The way it sounded… didn't feel like a lie.

Content.SourceString: 这样啊……那看来我们确实冤枉了团三郎。
Content.LocalizedString: I see… so it looks like we really wronged Danzaburou.

Content.SourceString: 还好问了一声鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Good thing I checked with the Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 等一下。你们可能只是冤枉了「这只」团三郎。
Content.LocalizedString: Hang on. You might be accusing the wrong Danzaburou.

Content.SourceString: 它既然自述「听说有好吃的」，那很可能是附近的其他团三郎曾经得手过，让它知道了这个信息。
Content.LocalizedString: If it said it had "heard there's good food here", then maybe some other Danzaburou nearby already stole the ingredients and passed the info along.

Content.SourceString: 报告异象管理局，让J.T.F去搜查一下附近有没有团三郎的巢穴吧。
Content.LocalizedString: You should report to the Bureau of Anomaly Control, and have JTF sweep the area for any Danzaburou nests.

Content.SourceString: ！！听上去很有道理。
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds about right.

Content.SourceString: 真是太感谢鉴定师了，现役专业人士就是不一样！
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you so much, Appraiser. A pro on the job really is in a league of their own!

Content.SourceString: 猫丸拉面的店主也说，等食材找回来了，要请你吃招牌拉面呢。
Content.LocalizedString: The owner of Nekomaru Ramen also said that once the ingredients are recovered, she'll treat you to her signature ramen.

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，在吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser? Appraiser, are you there?

Content.SourceString: 我在为我的水母征集名字，也想听听鉴定师的意见><
Content.LocalizedString: I'm collecting name ideas for my jellyfish, and I'd love to hear the Appraiser's suggestions too ><

OptionText.LocalizedString: So it didn't have a name?
Why the sudden urge to name it?

Content.SourceString: 原来海月的水母之前没有名字吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait—Aurelia's jellyfish didn't have a name before?

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然想起给水母起名了？
Content.LocalizedString: Why'd you suddenly think of naming the jellyfish?

Content.SourceString: ……因为我一直想不出来该叫它什么，干脆就没起名字了……
Content.LocalizedString: …because I could never think of what to call it, so I just never gave it a name…

Content.SourceString: 最近街上很多小孩都在问我这孩子叫什么，我完全答不上来……
Content.LocalizedString: Lately a bunch of kids on the street asked me what it's called, and I just didn't have an answer…

Content.SourceString: 这孩子和我相处了这么久，我却连名字都没法给它……稍微有些过意不去。
Content.LocalizedString: It's been with me so long, and I still haven't given it a name… I feel kinda bad about that.

Content.SourceString: 我姑且想了几个名字，鉴定师听听看？
Content.LocalizedString: I came up with a few names—wanna hear them, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 好，你说吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay, go ahead.

Content.SourceString: 「小海」「小月」「小蓝」还有「小粉」。
Content.LocalizedString: "Seaie", "Moony", "Bluey", and "Pinky".

Content.SourceString: 你别这样！我知道自己的取名品味很烂啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't be like that! I know my taste in names totally sucks!

Content.SourceString: 哭哭.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: boohoo.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不如从水母的外表入手呢？当然，小蓝小粉这种的还是有点太草率了……
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe start with the jellyfish's appearance? Calling it just "Seaie" or "Pinky" seems a bit lazy…

Content.SourceString: 不如从水母的性格入手呢？比如，它是活泼好动，还是乖巧懂事……
Content.LocalizedString: Why don't we start with the jellyfish's characteristic? Like, is it lively and fidgety, or calm and well-behaved…

Content.SourceString: 不如从水母的爱好入手呢？它有没有自己爱做的事？
Content.LocalizedString: How about we start with the jellyfish's hobbies? Does it have anything it likes to do?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……因为它是透明的，所以叫「小明」怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm… since it's transparent, how about calling it "Invisible"?

Content.SourceString: 它很听话，很乖巧懂事。叫它「小乖」怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: It's so obedient, so gentle and well-behaved. How about we call it "Goodie"?

Content.SourceString: 爱好吗……它喜欢到处飞来飞去。要不然，就叫它「小飞」吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Hobbies? It likes flitting around everywhere. Let's call it "Flyer".

Content.SourceString: ……我算是明白了，海月的取名品味完全是毁灭性的。
Content.LocalizedString: …Alright, I get it now. Aurelia's taste in names is absolutely catastrophic.

Content.SourceString: TAT
Content.LocalizedString: T_T

Content.SourceString: 刚刚试着用新名字叫了它一声，完全不理我。
Content.LocalizedString: I just tried calling it by its new name, and it totally ignored me.

Content.SourceString: 看上去它也不是很喜欢这个名字……
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like it's not that keen on that name either…

Content.SourceString: ……它的心情我也不是不能理解。
Content.LocalizedString: …I can actually understand how it feels.

Content.SourceString: 不过，海月能明白水母的心情吗？因为它没有表情，好像不是很好分辨。
Content.LocalizedString: But can Aurelia really understand the jellyfish's feelings? It has no expression, so it's hard to discern...

Content.SourceString: 嗯……可能是因为我们待在一起很久了吧，多少都能懂。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm… maybe it's because we've been together so long that I can just kinda tell.

Content.SourceString: 就像相处了很久的朋友或者家人那样，即使不说出口，即使不把表情写在脸上，也能明白对方的感受。
Content.LocalizedString: Like with friends and family who've known each other forever — you just understand how the other person feels, even if it's unsaid and their face is a blank slate.

Content.SourceString: 既然如此，我觉得海月也没必要执着于给它取一个名字。
Content.LocalizedString: In that case, I don't think Aurelia needs to be so hung up on giving it a name.

Content.SourceString: 即使不去命名，它对你而言也是独一无二的存在。即使海月不去呼唤，它也明白是在叫它。
Content.LocalizedString: Even without a name, it's unique to you. Even if Aurelia doesn't call aloud, it'll still understand you're calling.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师……
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 我明白了。嗯，在那个最合适的名字浮现在我的脑海之前，我不会再逼迫自己取一个名字了。
Content.LocalizedString: I get it. Mm… until the right name floats into my head, I won't force myself to pick one.

Content.SourceString: ……这样一来，它也放心了吧TwT
Content.LocalizedString: …That should put it at ease, right? TwT

Content.SourceString: 擦汗.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: wiping sweat.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你好，我是海月。擅自从明音那里要来了你的呗果联系方式，希望你不会介意><
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, I'm Aurelia. I kinda went and grabbed your Bagel contact from Akane without asking… hope you don't mind ><

Content.SourceString: 被明音出卖了啊。
Content.LocalizedString: So Akane sold me out, huh?

Content.SourceString: 没关系，我不介意。
Content.LocalizedString: It's okay, I don't mind.

Content.SourceString: 欸？！抱歉抱歉，原来你是不愿意和粉丝私联的类型啊……
Content.LocalizedString: Oh—! Sorry, sorry. So you're the kind of person who won't have private contact with fans…

Content.SourceString: 那太好了。原本还有点担心会被当成要私联的奇怪粉丝……
Content.LocalizedString: That's a relief. I was actually a little worried you'd think I was some weirdo fan trying to hit you up in private…

Content.SourceString: 私联？
Content.LocalizedString: Private contact?

Content.SourceString: 粉丝？
Content.LocalizedString: Fan?

Content.SourceString: 虽然没有偶像那么夸张，不过也会有一些激进的粉丝想要私下近距离接触乐队成员。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not as over the top as idol culture, but there are still some intense fans who try to get up close with the band members in private.

Content.SourceString: 猫头音！！！！今后也要多加注意，不要和奇怪的人来往哦。
Content.LocalizedString: THE WHOOTS!!!! From now on, be extra careful. Don't hang out with weirdos, okay?

OptionText.SourceString: 海月遇到过奇怪的人吗？
OptionText.LocalizedString: Aurelia, have you ever met any strange people?

Content.SourceString: 海月是奇怪的人吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is Aurelia a weirdo?

Content.SourceString: 海月遇到过奇怪的人吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Aurelia, have you ever met any strange people?

Content.SourceString: 虽然很想斩钉截铁地说不是！……但真正奇怪的人肯定不会承认的吧？
Content.LocalizedString: I'd really like to say 'no' for sure… but a truly eccentric person wouldn't admit it, would they?

Content.SourceString: 其实也没有。「平行线」当时不仅是乐队，还是异象猎人组织，奇怪的人不是很敢接近我们。
Content.LocalizedString: Not really. Back then, Lines was both a band and Anomaly Hunter organization, so weirdos didn't dare come near us.

Content.SourceString: 不过我自己毕竟也做过乐队，很明白什么事会让乐手困扰。绝对不会故意打扰你们的！
Content.LocalizedString: But I've been in a band myself, so I know exactly what kind of stuff gets on musicians' nerves. I'd never bother you guys on purpose!

Content.SourceString: 说起来，海月曾经和明音一起组过乐队是吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, Aurelia—didn't you and Akane used to be in a band together?

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯。虽然乐队没能持续很久，不过那段时间很开心哦。
Content.LocalizedString: Mmhm. The band didn't last long, but those were really good times.

Content.SourceString: 顺带一提我当时是鼓手，和你一样XD
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, I was the drummer back then too, just like you XD

Content.SourceString: 原来海月是我的前辈。
Content.LocalizedString: Then it turns out Aurelia's my senpai.

Content.SourceString: 难怪海月会来加我。是因为同一个位置会比较亲切吗？
Content.LocalizedString: No wonder Aurelia added me. Maybe it's because we're in the same role and that makes things feel more familiar?

Content.SourceString: 不敢当不敢当。我自己也是半路出家的类型，称不上什么前辈。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, don't flatter me. I'm kind of a latecomer myself—I hardly count as a senpai.

Content.SourceString: 嘿嘿，多少有一点这样的心情吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, I guess I do feel that way, if only a little.

Content.SourceString: 不过，如果你遇到什么困难，可以来找我商量哦。
Content.LocalizedString: If you run into trouble, please come talk to me.

Content.SourceString: 有一些感受，只有担任同样乐器的同伴才能理解吧？
Content.LocalizedString: There are some feelings that only companions who play the same instruments can get, right?

Content.SourceString: 总之！我是想说，你们的演出真的很精彩，让我深受感动！
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway—what I wanted to say is, your performance was incredible. It really moved me!

Content.SourceString: 以后我也会一直支持你们的！
Content.LocalizedString: From now on, I'll always have your back!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你有没有逛过夜间集市？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you ever been to a night market?

Content.SourceString: 为什么问这个？
Content.LocalizedString: Why do you ask?

Content.SourceString: 其实是工作相关的问题……
Content.LocalizedString: It's actually about work…

Content.SourceString: 我在为玉饼街策划一次夜市活动，但思路有点卡壳，正在寻找灵感TwT
Content.LocalizedString: I'm putting together a night market on Tamamochi Street, but I'm totally out of ideas. I could really use some inspiration TwT

OptionText.LocalizedString: Sounds like a lot of work.

Content.SourceString: 听上去好像很有趣。
Content.LocalizedString: That actually sounds pretty fun!

Content.SourceString: 策划一条街道的活动……听上去还挺辛苦的。
Content.LocalizedString: You're planning an event for the whole street? That's a lot to take on!

Content.SourceString: 如果最后的活动效果能像你期待的那么有趣就太好了~
Content.LocalizedString: Hope it turns out just as fun as you're imagining!

Content.SourceString: 是有很多困难，不过也很有意思！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, it's definitely a challenge, but I'm super excited about it!

Content.SourceString: 要是鉴定师感兴趣，要不要来玉饼街看看，实地帮我参谋一下？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, Appraiser, wanna swing by Tamamochi Street and help me brainstorm some ideas?

Content.SourceString: 我这就来。
Content.LocalizedString: Be right there!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，还记得我们的约定吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, Appraiser! Remember that little promise we made?

Content.LocalizedString: Wait, what promise?

Content.SourceString: 是海月说好要做的蛋糕吧。
Content.LocalizedString: You promised to make me a cake, right, Aurelia?

Content.SourceString: 欸，这么快就忘了吗？

Content.LocalizedString: The lights are coming on, and the night's just getting started! The Tamamochi Street Night Market kicks off tonight at 8 PM! Come check out all the stalls, with food, shopping, games, and tons more...

Content.LocalizedString: Seriously, though, I couldn't have pulled off this night market without your help, Appraiser. If you're free tonight, you should totally come check it out!
